mapper.insert: INSERT INTO analysis_relation (revision_id, from_kind, from_id, relation_type, to_kind, to_id, to_external , confidence, resolution_status, properties_json, file_id, line_start) VALUES (#{revisionId}, #{fromKind}, #{fromId}, #{relationType}, #{toKind}, #{toId}, #{toExternal} , #{confidence}, #{resolutionStatus}, CAST(#{propertiesJson} AS jsonb), #{fileId}, #{lineStart, jdbcType=INTEGER})

WITH RECURSIVE ancestor (type_id, ancestor_id, depth) AS ( SELECT r.from_id, r.to_id, 1 FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.relation_type IN ('EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS') AND r.to_id IS NOT NULL UNION SELECT a.type_id, r.to_id, a.depth + 1 FROM ancestor a JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_id = a.ancestor_id AND r.relation_type IN ('EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS') AND r.to_id IS NOT NULL WHERE a.depth < 20 ) INSERT INTO analysis_relation (revision_id, from_kind, from_id, relation_type, to_kind, to_id, confidence, resolution_status) SELECT DISTINCT #{revisionId}, 'METHOD', m.method_id, 'OVERRIDES', 'METHOD', pm.method_id , CASE WHEN m.signature = pm.signature THEN 'HIGH' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END , CASE WHEN m.signature = pm.signature THEN 'RESOLVED' ELSE 'HEURISTIC' END FROM ( -- 순환 상속(A extends B, B extends A: 컴파일은 안 되지만 소스에는 있을 수 있다)이면 -- 따라 올라가다 자기 자신이 상위 타입으로 나온다. 그 행은 뺀다(메소드가 자기 자신을 재정의한다고 적지 않게). SELECT DISTINCT type_id, ancestor_id FROM ancestor WHERE type_id <> ancestor_id ) a JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.owner_symbol_id = a.type_id AND NOT m.is_constructor AND NOT m.is_static JOIN analysis_method pm ON pm.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND pm.owner_symbol_id = a.ancestor_id AND pm.name = m.name AND pm.param_count = m.param_count AND NOT pm.is_constructor AND NOT pm.is_static AND COALESCE(pm.visibility, '') <> 'private' WHERE m.signature = pm.signature OR NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM analysis_method x WHERE x.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND x.owner_symbol_id = a.ancestor_id AND x.signature = m.signature)

INSERT INTO analysis_relation (revision_id, from_kind, from_id, relation_type, to_kind, to_id, confidence, resolution_status, properties_json, file_id, line_start) SELECT c.revision_id, c.from_kind, c.from_id, 'CALLS_POSSIBLE_IMPLEMENTATION', 'METHOD', o.from_id , 'MEDIUM' , 'HEURISTIC' , jsonb_build_object('declared', c.to_id) , c.file_id, c.line_start FROM analysis_relation c JOIN analysis_relation o ON o.revision_id = c.revision_id AND o.relation_type = 'OVERRIDES' AND o.to_id = c.to_id JOIN analysis_method target ON target.revision_id = c.revision_id AND target.method_id = c.to_id AND target.is_abstract JOIN analysis_method impl ON impl.revision_id = c.revision_id AND impl.method_id = o.from_id AND NOT impl.is_abstract WHERE c.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND c.relation_type = 'CALLS' AND c.to_id IS NOT NULL

INSERT INTO analysis_metric (analysis_id, metric_name, metric_value) SELECT #{analysisId}, 'parseSuccessRate' , ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parse_status = 'OK') / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE parse_status <> 'SKIPPED'), 0), 2) FROM analysis_file WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND language = 'JAVA' UNION ALL SELECT #{analysisId}, 'callCount', COUNT(*) FROM analysis_reference WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND ref_kind = 'CALL' UNION ALL SELECT #{analysisId}, 'callResolutionRate' , ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('RESOLVED', 'EXTERNAL')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) FROM analysis_reference WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND ref_kind = 'CALL' UNION ALL SELECT #{analysisId}, 'callHeuristicRate' , ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'HEURISTIC') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) FROM analysis_reference WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND ref_kind = 'CALL' UNION ALL SELECT #{analysisId}, 'callUnresolvedRate' , ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status = 'UNRESOLVED') / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) FROM analysis_reference WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND ref_kind = 'CALL' UNION ALL SELECT #{analysisId}, 'typeResolutionRate' , ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status IN ('RESOLVED', 'EXTERNAL')) / NULLIF(COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE status <> 'IGNORED'), 0), 2) FROM analysis_reference WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND ref_kind IN ('TYPE_USE', 'EXTENDS', 'IMPLEMENTS', 'THROWS', 'CREATE', 'ANONYMOUS_SUPER') UNION ALL SELECT #{analysisId}, 'relationCount', COUNT(*) FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId}
mapper.select: SELECT m.metric_name AS "name", m.metric_value AS "value", m.analysis_id AS "analysisId" FROM analysis_metric m WHERE m.analysis_id = ( SELECT j.analysis_id FROM analysis_job j JOIN analysis_metric x ON x.analysis_id = j.analysis_id WHERE j.revision_id = #{revisionId} ORDER BY j.created_at DESC, j.analysis_id DESC LIMIT 1) ORDER BY m.metric_name

SELECT relation_type AS "relationType" , to_kind AS "toKind" , confidence AS "confidence" , COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_relation WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} GROUP BY relation_type, to_kind, confidence ORDER BY relation_type, to_kind, confidence

SELECT ref_kind AS "refKind" , status AS "status" , split_part(COALESCE(fail_reason, ''), '. ', 1) AS "reason" , COUNT(*) AS "count" , MIN(fail_reason) AS "example" FROM analysis_reference WHERE revision_id = #{revisionId} AND status IN ('UNRESOLVED', 'IGNORED') GROUP BY ref_kind, status, split_part(COALESCE(fail_reason, ''), '. ', 1) ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 20
mapper.sql: CASE WHEN r.fail_reason LIKE '%Unsolved symbol%' AND r.fail_reason LIKE '% : %' THEN LEFT(regexp_replace(substring(r.fail_reason FROM '.* : (.*)$'), ' in context .*$', ''), 200) ELSE split_part(COALESCE(NULLIF(r.fail_reason, ''), '(이유가 적혀 있지 않음)'), '. ', 1) END
mapper.select: SELECT g.cause AS "cause", md5(g.cause) AS "causeKey", COUNT(*) AS "count", COUNT(DISTINCT g.file_id) AS "files", MIN(g.fail_reason) AS "example" FROM (SELECT AS cause, r.file_id, r.fail_reason FROM analysis_reference r JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = r.file_id ) g GROUP BY g.cause ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, g.cause LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.file_id AS "fileId", f.path AS "path", COUNT(*) AS "count" FROM analysis_reference r JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = r.file_id
GROUP BY r.file_id, f.path ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, f.path LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT r.name AS "name", COUNT(*) AS "count", COUNT(DISTINCT r.file_id) AS "files" FROM analysis_reference r JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = r.file_id
GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, r.name LIMIT #{limit}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_reference r JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = r.file_id

SELECT r.reference_id AS "referenceId" , f.path AS "path" , r.line_start AS "lineStart" , r.ref_kind AS "refKind" , r.status AS "status" , r.scope_text AS "scopeText" , r.name AS "name" , r.arg_count AS "argCount" , m.signature AS "fromMethod" , AS "cause" , r.fail_reason AS "reason" FROM analysis_reference r JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = r.file_id LEFT JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = r.revision_id AND m.method_id = r.from_id AND r.from_kind = 'METHOD'
ORDER BY f.path, r.line_start, r.column_start, r.reference_id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
mapper.sql: m.method_id AS "methodId" , s.fqn AS "ownerFqn" , m.signature AS "signature" , m.return_type AS "returnType" , m.is_abstract AS "isAbstract" , m.is_synthetic AS "isSynthetic" , f.path AS "path" , m.line_start AS "lineStart" , m.line_end AS "lineEnd"
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM analysis_method m JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = m.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id

SELECT FROM analysis_method m JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = m.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = m.file_id
ORDER BY s.fqn, m.signature LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}

WITH RECURSIVE walk (depth, from_id, from_kind, to_id, relation_type, confidence, file_id, line_start, props) AS ( SELECT 1, r.from_id, r.from_kind, r.to_id, r.relation_type, r.confidence, r.file_id, r.line_start, r.properties_json FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.to_id = #{methodId} AND r.relation_type IN #{type} UNION SELECT w.depth + 1, r.from_id, r.from_kind, r.to_id, r.relation_type, r.confidence, r.file_id, r.line_start, r.properties_json FROM walk w JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.to_id = w.from_id AND r.relation_type IN #{type} WHERE w.depth < #{depth} ) SELECT w.depth AS "depth" , w.relation_type AS "relationType" , w.confidence AS "confidence" , w.from_kind AS "fromKind" , w.from_id AS "fromId" , n.fqn AS "from" , w.to_id AS "toId" , t.fqn AS "to" -- 화면 → 메소드(REQUESTS)의 근거: 화면 글자(PATH_TEXT)인지 불러온 스크립트(SCRIPT_SRC)인지, 요청 주소, 주소가 적힌 스크립트와 그 줄 , w.props ->> 'via' AS "via" , w.props ->> 'path' AS "requestPath" , w.props ->> 'script' AS "script" , (w.props ->> 'scriptLine')::int AS "scriptLine" -- 부르는 쪽이 화면이면 화면명. 한글 화면명(SCREEN_NAME)이 먼저, 없으면 화면 사전(DICT_SCREEN_NAME), 그것도 없으면 찾은 이름 그대로 , CASE WHEN w.from_kind = 'FILE' THEN COALESCE((SELECT r.value FROM analysis_resource r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.file_id = w.file_id AND r.resource_type = 'SCREEN_NAME' AND r.value ~ '[가-힣]' ORDER BY r.resource_id LIMIT 1) , (SELECT r.value FROM analysis_resource r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.file_id = w.file_id AND r.resource_type = 'DICT_SCREEN_NAME' ORDER BY r.resource_id LIMIT 1) , (SELECT r.value FROM analysis_resource r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.file_id = w.file_id AND r.resource_type = 'SCREEN_NAME' ORDER BY r.resource_id LIMIT 1)) END AS "screenName" , f.path AS "path" , w.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM ( -- 서로를 부르는 메소드(a → b → a)가 있으면 같은 호출이 깊이를 바꿔 가며 다시 나온다. 가장 얕은 것 하나만 남긴다. SELECT MIN(depth) AS depth, from_id, from_kind, to_id, relation_type, confidence, file_id, line_start, props FROM walk GROUP BY from_id, from_kind, to_id, relation_type, confidence, file_id, line_start, props ) w LEFT JOIN kg_node n ON n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.node_id = w.from_id -- 이 단계에서 불리는 쪽. 화면 한 줄이 여러 주소를 요청하면 이 열과 요청 주소로 줄이 구분된다. LEFT JOIN kg_node t ON t.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND t.node_id = w.to_id LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = w.file_id ORDER BY w.depth, n.fqn, w.line_start, t.fqn LIMIT #{limit}

WITH RECURSIVE walk (depth, from_id, to_kind, to_id, to_external, relation_type, confidence, file_id, line_start) AS ( SELECT 1, r.from_id, r.to_kind, r.to_id, r.to_external, r.relation_type, r.confidence, r.file_id, r.line_start FROM analysis_relation r WHERE r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_id = #{methodId} AND r.relation_type IN #{type} UNION SELECT w.depth + 1, r.from_id, r.to_kind, r.to_id, r.to_external, r.relation_type, r.confidence, r.file_id, r.line_start FROM walk w JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_id = w.to_id AND r.relation_type IN #{type} WHERE w.depth < #{depth} ) SELECT w.depth AS "depth" , w.relation_type AS "relationType" , w.confidence AS "confidence" , w.from_id AS "fromId" , w.to_kind AS "toKind" , w.to_id AS "toId" , COALESCE(n.fqn, w.to_external) AS "to" , f.path AS "path" , w.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM ( SELECT MIN(depth) AS depth, from_id, to_kind, to_id, to_external, relation_type, confidence, file_id, line_start FROM walk GROUP BY from_id, to_kind, to_id, to_external, relation_type, confidence, file_id, line_start ) w LEFT JOIN kg_node n ON n.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND n.node_id = w.to_id LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = w.file_id WHERE w.to_id IS NOT NULL OR w.to_kind = 'TABLE' ORDER BY w.depth, w.from_id, w.line_start LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.sql: (CASE ${column} WHEN 'HIGH' THEN 3 WHEN 'MEDIUM' THEN 2 ELSE 1 END)
(CASE ${column} WHEN 3 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN 2 THEN 'MEDIUM' ELSE 'LOW' END)

choose.when: SELECT s.fqn AS "ownerFqn" , m.signature AS "signature" , s.layer AS "layer" , f.path AS "path" , m.line_start AS "lineStart" , (SELECT r.value FROM analysis_resource r WHERE r.revision_id = m.revision_id AND r.resource_type = 'METHOD_TITLE' AND r.name = m.method_id ORDER BY r.resource_id LIMIT 1) AS "title" FROM analysis_method m JOIN analysis_symbol s ON s.revision_id = m.revision_id AND s.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = m.file_id WHERE m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.method_id = #{target}

SELECT s.simple_name AS "simpleName" , s.kind AS "typeKind" , s.layer AS "layer" , f.path AS "path" , s.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM analysis_symbol s JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = s.file_id WHERE s.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND s.fqn = #{target} ORDER BY s.file_id LIMIT 1

SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(mp.namespace, '') || '.', '') || mp.statement_id AS "statement" , mp.statement_type AS "statementType" , f.path AS "path" , mp.line_start AS "lineStart" , COUNT(*) OVER () AS "matches" FROM analysis_mapper mp JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = mp.file_id WHERE mp.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND (mp.statement_id = #{target} OR mp.namespace || '.' || mp.statement_id = #{target}) ORDER BY f.path, mp.line_start LIMIT 1

mapper.select: SELECT a.depth AS "depth" , AS "confidence" , m.method_id AS "methodId" , o.fqn || '#' || m.signature AS "method" , o.layer AS "layer" , f.path AS "path" , m.line_start AS "lineStart" FROM affected a JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.method_id = a.node_id JOIN analysis_symbol o ON o.revision_id = m.revision_id AND o.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id LEFT JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = m.file_id WHERE a.node_kind = 'METHOD' ORDER BY a.depth, o.fqn, m.signature LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT x.* FROM ( SELECT e.endpoint_type AS "endpointType" , e.http_method AS "httpMethod" , e.path AS "path" , o.fqn || '#' || m.signature AS "handler" , m.method_id AS "methodId" , a.depth AS "depth" , AS "confidence" , 'METHOD' AS "matchedBy" FROM affected a JOIN analysis_endpoint e ON e.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND e.method_id = a.node_id JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = e.revision_id AND m.method_id = e.method_id JOIN analysis_symbol o ON o.revision_id = m.revision_id AND o.symbol_id = m.owner_symbol_id WHERE a.node_kind = 'METHOD' UNION ALL SELECT e.endpoint_type, e.http_method, e.path, o.fqn, NULL, t.depth, 'LOW', 'TYPE' FROM (SELECT m.owner_symbol_id, MIN(a.depth) AS depth FROM affected a JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.method_id = a.node_id WHERE a.node_kind = 'METHOD' GROUP BY m.owner_symbol_id) t JOIN analysis_endpoint e ON e.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND e.symbol_id = t.owner_symbol_id AND e.method_id IS NULL JOIN analysis_symbol o ON o.revision_id = e.revision_id AND o.symbol_id = e.symbol_id ) x ORDER BY x."depth", x."path", x."handler" LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT x.path AS "path" , MIN(x.depth) AS "depth" , AS "confidence" , array_to_string(array_agg(DISTINCT x.via), ',') AS "via" FROM ( SELECT 'REQUESTS' AS via, f.path, a.depth, a.conf FROM affected a JOIN analysis_file f ON f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.file_id = CAST(substr(a.node_id, 2) AS bigint) WHERE a.node_kind = 'FILE' UNION ALL SELECT 'CALLS', f.path, a.depth, a.conf FROM affected a JOIN analysis_method m ON m.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND m.method_id = a.node_id JOIN analysis_file f ON f.file_id = m.file_id AND f.language = 'JSP' WHERE a.node_kind = 'METHOD' UNION ALL SELECT 'RENDERS', f.path, a.depth, LEAST(a.conf, ) FROM affected a JOIN analysis_relation r ON r.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND r.from_id = a.node_id AND r.relation_type = 'RENDERS' AND r.to_kind = 'FILE' JOIN analysis_file f ON f.revision_id = #{revisionId} AND f.file_id = CAST(substr(r.to_id, 2) AS bigint) WHERE a.node_kind = 'METHOD' ) x GROUP BY x.path ORDER BY MIN(x.depth), x.path LIMIT #{limit}
